scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with exact rational finite diagnostics; no claim to generic integral extremizers or previously solved diameter-three bistar inradius. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two leaf-bearing ends of a three-vertex path, unit edge lengths, uniform vertex masses, real Lipschitz L2 variance; not a general tree/weighted metric theorem.
source_ids: Sharp Euclidean inballs and contact-facet transitions for bistar symmetric edge polytopes (public result, 2026)
title: Sharp Lipschitz spread of length-two double brooms and its three-to-one branching transition
